name: first-forward-dashboard
description: First Forward FASTag dashboard — login-protected issuance, stock, trends and agent performance from a Google Sheet (StockDataa + REPORT), with settings & per-user permissions.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in config util xlsx data charts model store auth sheets dashboard trend stock performance settings app; do node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('$f.js','utf8'))" || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok
